sentences.text: Did you know a pigeon saved lives during the war?
In the village square, messages were sent by bird.
One day, Ella received a crucial message.
But the messenger was shot down by a sniper.
Only the pigeon could deliver now.
With a heavy heart, Ella sent the pigeon.
You see, even in war, small birds can make a big difference.
How can a tiny creature change the course of a war?
Just like how a single light can brighten a dark room.
You never know when a pigeon will save the day.
